title: Soul Grinder
summary: Soul Grinder is a horde survival action rogue-like. Survive an onslaught of enemies with necromancy and dark magic at your disposal! Try to survive as long as you can and collect gems to upgrade your power.
body:
Soul Grinder is a horde survival action rogue-like. Survive an onslaught of enemies with necromancy and dark magic at your disposal! Try to survive as long as you can and collect gems to upgrade your power.

I built Soul Grinder over the course of two weeks as personal challenge and break from my main project. I wanted to try building a game like vampire survivors with a twist of necromancy. Ultimately the game felt less original than I wanted. There's a lot more features I would like to have added but I decided to move forward with different projects. Still, I'm happy with how the game turned out and how much I was able to accomplish in such a short time span.
